en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abu’l Khattab narrated to us from Nasr b. Mazahim from `Umar b. Sa`d from `Amr b. Thabit from Habib b. Abu Thabit from Umm Salama, wife of the Prophet (s).

She said: I had not heard the wailing of the jinn since the Prophet (sw) was taken until this night and I didn’t see it except due to what has afflicted my son. She said: A jinniyyah (female jinn) from among them came saying: ‘O eye! Now shed tears strenuously, for who shall weep over the martyrs after me  over a clan whom death is leading, towards a despot in the kingdom of a slave’.
